words.enDefinition: Planning how an offering will reach its intended buyers through distribution

examples.en: Our case compares two approaches to channel design for a fictional stationery brand.
examples.zh: 课程案例比较了虚构文具品牌的两种「分销渠道设计」方案。

examples.en: We discussed channel design before choosing which actors to include in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论了「分销渠道设计」，再决定在示意图中纳入哪些参与方。

words.enDefinition: Number of intermediary levels between the producer and the final buyer

examples.en: The two cases differ in channel length because only one uses a wholesaler.
examples.zh: 两个案例的「渠道长度」不同，因为只有一个案例使用了批发商。

examples.en: Our group marked each stage before discussing channel length in the fictional network.
examples.zh: 我们组先标出各个环节，再讨论虚构网络的「渠道长度」。

words.enDefinition: A stage consisting of an intermediary or a group of similar intermediaries along a distribution channel.

examples.en: The example adds another channel level between the manufacturer and the neighborhood shops.
examples.zh: 示例在制造商与社区商店之间增加了一个「渠道层级」。

examples.en: We labeled the channel level where goods were sold to individual customers.
examples.zh: 我们标出了商品卖给个人顾客时所处的「渠道层级」。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which an offering is distributed through available outlets

examples.en: The class compares channel intensity for products sold widely and through selected outlets.
examples.zh: 课堂比较了广泛销售和只在部分选定网点销售的产品的「渠道覆盖密度」。

examples.en: We discussed whether a higher channel intensity would change the mock distribution map.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了更高的「渠道覆盖密度」是否会改变模拟分销地图。

collocations: choose a level of channel intensity

words.enDefinition: Organization participating in the distribution of an offering to buyers

examples.en: The case assigns a different responsibility to each channel member in the network.
examples.zh: 案例为网络中的各个「渠道成员」分配了不同的职责。

examples.en: We asked which channel member handles questions after goods reach the retailer.
examples.zh: 我们问，在商品到达零售商之后，由哪个「渠道成员」处理咨询。

words.enDefinition: Business connecting producers with buyers by supporting the distribution of offerings

examples.en: The fictional marketing intermediary helps the publisher reach shops in smaller towns.
examples.zh: 虚构的「营销中间商」帮助出版商接触到小城镇的商店。

examples.en: We compared a marketing intermediary that holds stock with one matching buyers and sellers.
examples.zh: 我们对比了持有库存的「营销中间商」与牵线促成买卖的中间商。

words.enDefinition: Distribution from producers to end users without independent sales intermediaries

examples.en: In the case, direct distribution lets the maker sell straight to local libraries.
examples.zh: 在案例中，「直接分销」使生产商能够直接向当地各图书馆销售。

examples.en: We compared direct distribution with a route that includes a regional distributor.
examples.zh: 我们对照了「直接分销」与经过区域分销商的销售路径。

words.enDefinition: Distribution of an offering through one or more intermediaries

examples.en: The fictional maker uses indirect distribution to reach stores outside its own town.
examples.zh: 虚构生产商通过「间接分销」接触本城以外的门店。

examples.en: We traced indirect distribution through the wholesaler and retailer on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图上沿着批发商和零售商追踪了「间接分销」路径。

words.enDefinition: Selling an offering through both direct and intermediary routes in parallel

examples.en: The fictional maker uses dual distribution by selling online and through independent shops.
examples.zh: 虚构生产商既在网上直售，也通过独立商店销售，采用了「双重分销」。

examples.en: We identified dual distribution after tracing the same product through direct and indirect routes.
examples.zh: 我们追查了同一产品经直接与间接路径销售的情况，辨认出了「双重分销」。

words.enDefinition: Distribution system of independent firms pursuing their own objectives at each level

examples.en: The chart shows a conventional marketing system in which firms keep separate pricing decisions.
examples.zh: 图表展示了一个各家公司分别定价的「传统营销渠道系统」。

examples.en: We compared the conventional marketing system with a network coordinated under common ownership.
examples.zh: 我们将「传统营销渠道系统」与统一所有权下协调运作的网络作了比较。

collocations: members of a conventional marketing system

words.enDefinition: Distribution arrangement in which firms at successive channel stages operate in coordination

examples.en: The lecture introduces a vertical marketing system through a producer coordinating with its retailers.
examples.zh: 讲座通过生产商与零售商协调运作的情况介绍了「垂直营销渠道系统」。

examples.en: We identified the vertical marketing system in the diagram showing a manufacturer and its retail branches.
examples.zh: 我们在一家生产商及其零售分支的示意图中辨认出了「垂直营销渠道系统」。

collocations: coordination in a vertical marketing system

words.enDefinition: Coordinated distribution system with successive channel stages under common ownership

examples.en: The case shows a corporate vertical marketing system owned by the fictional notebook manufacturer.
examples.zh: 案例展示了一个由虚构笔记本制造商拥有的「公司型垂直营销系统」。

examples.en: We traced store ownership to identify the corporate vertical marketing system in the example.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了门店的所有权，以辨认出示例中的「公司型垂直营销系统」。

collocations: operate a corporate vertical marketing system
examples of a corporate vertical marketing system
ownership in a corporate vertical marketing system

words.enDefinition: Coordinated distribution system in which independent firms cooperate under formal agreements

examples.en: The textbook uses an invented franchise network to illustrate a contractual vertical marketing system.
examples.zh: 教材用虚构的特许经营网络举例说明「契约型垂直营销系统」。

examples.en: We discussed how independent parties could coordinate under a contractual vertical marketing system in the case.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了案例中的独立各方如何在「契约型垂直营销系统」中协调运作。

collocations: form a contractual vertical marketing system
participants in a contractual vertical marketing system
model a contractual vertical marketing system

words.enDefinition: Coordinated distribution system led by a member's influence rather than common ownership

examples.en: In the case, a powerful retailer coordinates an administered vertical marketing system without owning suppliers.
examples.zh: 在案例中，一家有影响力的零售商协调「管理型垂直营销系统」，无需拥有供应商。

examples.en: We asked how much influence supported the administered vertical marketing system in the fictional network.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在虚构网络中，需要多大的影响力才能维持「管理型垂直营销系统」。

collocations: identify an administered vertical marketing system
leadership in an administered vertical marketing system
example of an administered vertical marketing system

words.enDefinition: Arrangement where organizations at the same channel level work together to reach buyers

examples.en: The horizontal marketing system in the case lets two retailers share space for one offering.
examples.zh: 案例中的「水平营销渠道系统」让两家零售商共用场地销售同一产品。

examples.en: We looked for a horizontal marketing system among the distributors operating at the same level.
examples.zh: 我们在同一层级经营的分销商中寻找「水平营销渠道系统」。

collocations: example of a horizontal marketing system
cooperate in a horizontal marketing system

words.enDefinition: Channel member taking the lead in coordinating other participants' distribution activities

examples.en: The logistics firm acts as channel captain in our classroom distribution case.
examples.zh: 在我们的课堂分销案例中，物流公司充当「渠道领导者」。

examples.en: We identified the channel captain by checking who coordinated schedules across the network.
examples.zh: 我们查看谁负责协调网络内的各方日程，从而辨认出「渠道领导者」。

words.enDefinition: Ability of one distribution participant to influence decisions of other participants

examples.en: The case explores how reliable access to stock can create channel power.
examples.zh: 案例探讨稳定获得库存如何产生「渠道权力」。

examples.en: We discussed channel power when the fictional retailer could easily switch to other suppliers.
examples.zh: 课堂讨论了虚构零售商可以轻易更换供应商时的「渠道权力」。

words.enDefinition: Rules and arrangements guiding relationships and decisions among distribution participants

examples.en: The report describes channel governance through its rules for sharing inventory information.
examples.zh: 报告通过库存信息共享规则来说明「渠道治理」。

examples.en: We compared channel governance across two hypothetical distributor agreements with different responsibilities.
examples.zh: 我们比较了职责不同的两份假想分销商协议中的「渠道治理」。

words.enDefinition: Evaluation and choice of organizations that will distribute an offering

examples.en: Our group discussed channel partner selection after comparing coverage and service in the role-play.
examples.zh: 我们组在角色扮演练习中比较了覆盖范围和服务，随后讨论了「渠道伙伴选择」。

examples.en: The example gives technical support more weight during channel partner selection than geographic reach.
examples.zh: 示例中的「渠道伙伴选择」更看重技术支持，而不是地理覆盖范围。

words.enDefinition: Results achieved by a distribution route or its participating organizations

examples.en: The report tracks channel performance using timely deliveries and availability at the retailer.
examples.zh: 报告用交付是否及时以及零售处是否有货来跟踪「渠道绩效」。

examples.en: We compared channel performance across two different routes in the fictional distribution network.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构分销网络中两条不同路径的「渠道绩效」。

words.enDefinition: Disagreement among participants whose distribution goals or activities interfere with one another

examples.en: The case illustrates channel conflict when two partners disagree over who handles returns.
examples.zh: 案例用两个伙伴对由谁处理退货意见不一来说明「渠道冲突」。

examples.en: We discussed a channel conflict after the fictional distributor changed its service commitments.
examples.zh: 虚构分销商改变服务承诺之后，我们讨论了一项「渠道冲突」。

words.enDefinition: Disagreement between businesses at different levels of the same distribution channel

examples.en: The manufacturer and retailer disagree about delivery support, illustrating vertical channel conflict in the case.
examples.zh: 案例中的生产商和零售商就配送支持意见不一，体现了「垂直渠道冲突」。

examples.en: We marked the two levels involved in vertical channel conflict on the class chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表上标出了涉及「垂直渠道冲突」的两个层级。

words.enDefinition: Disagreement between businesses occupying the same level in a distribution channel

examples.en: The horizontal channel conflict in the exercise involves two retailers disputing their sales territories.
examples.zh: 练习中的「水平渠道冲突」涉及两家零售商就销售区域发生争议。

examples.en: We asked whether a dispute between two wholesalers counted as horizontal channel conflict.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了两家批发商之间的争议是否算「水平渠道冲突」。

words.enDefinition: Disagreement or friction arising when different selling channels overlap in serving customers

examples.en: The case describes multichannel conflict when direct online sales overlap with dealers' sales.
examples.zh: 案例描述了线上直销与经销商销售重合时的「多渠道冲突」。

examples.en: We read the distributor's comments before discussing multichannel conflict in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先阅读分销商的意见，再讨论习题中的「多渠道冲突」。

words.enDefinition: Removal of an intermediary stage from an established distribution route

examples.en: The example shows disintermediation when the publisher bypasses its former distributor.
examples.zh: 示例中，出版商绕过原先的分销商，体现了「去中介化」。

examples.en: We compared the two channel diagrams to see where disintermediation occurred.
examples.zh: 我们对比了两幅渠道示意图，查看「去中介化」发生在哪个环节。

words.enDefinition: Emergence or addition of intermediaries after a distribution route becomes more direct

examples.en: The case shows reintermediation when a new marketplace links makers and buyers again.
examples.zh: 案例中，新的交易平台重新连接生产商和买家，表现出「再中介化」。

examples.en: The case illustrated reintermediation when a booking platform took over sales previously handled directly by the venues.
examples.zh: 一家订票平台接手原由场馆直接完成的销售，案例用这一变化说明「再中介化」。

words.enDefinition: Making an offering available through as many suitable outlets as possible

examples.en: The case proposes intensive distribution for a low-cost item bought frequently by commuters.
examples.zh: 案例建议对通勤者经常购买的一种低价商品采用「密集分销」。

examples.en: We compared intensive distribution with a plan using only a few specialized outlets.
examples.zh: 我们将「密集分销」与仅经少数专门网点销售的方案作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Distribution of an offering through a chosen subset of available outlets

examples.en: The appliance case uses selective distribution and chooses outlets that can explain the product.
examples.zh: 家电案例采用「选择性分销」，挑选能够讲解产品的网点。

examples.en: We discussed selective distribution after comparing retailer service in the class handout.
examples.zh: 我们比较了课堂讲义中的零售服务之后，讨论了「选择性分销」。

words.enDefinition: Arrangement granting one partner sole distribution rights in a specified territory

examples.en: The fictional agreement grants territorial exclusivity to one distributor within the marked region.
examples.zh: 虚构协议赋予一家分销商在地图所标区域内的「区域独家经营」权。

examples.en: Our group drew the boundary to explain territorial exclusivity in the sample contract.
examples.zh: 我们组画出了区域边界，解释合同示例中的「区域独家经营」。

words.enDefinition: Extent to which one firm relies on another participant in its distribution

examples.en: The fictional supplier has high channel dependence because most sales flow through one retailer.
examples.zh: 虚构供应商的「渠道依赖」较高，因为多数销售都通过一家零售商完成。

examples.en: We discussed channel dependence after looking at the number of alternative outlets.
examples.zh: 我们查看了可替代网点的数量，再讨论「渠道依赖」。

words.enDefinition: Benefit offered to encourage a distribution partner to perform certain activities

examples.en: The manufacturer in the case offers a channel incentive for better stocking service.
examples.zh: 案例中的制造商为更好的备货服务提供一项「渠道激励措施」。

examples.en: We discussed how the channel incentive might change the distributor's willingness to participate.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「渠道激励措施」可能如何改变分销商的参与意愿。

words.enDefinition: Intermediary buying industrial supplies for resale to other businesses or institutions

examples.en: The fictional industrial distributor supplies components to repair workshops and manufacturing plants.
examples.zh: 虚构「工业品经销商」向维修工场和制造厂供应零部件。

examples.en: We traced the components through an industrial distributor before they reached the workshop.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了零部件到达工场之前经过「工业品经销商」的过程。

words.enDefinition: Independent seller granted permission by a producer to sell specified products

examples.en: The case assigns the repair equipment line to an authorized dealer with trained staff.
examples.zh: 案例将维修设备产品线交给一家人员受过培训的「授权经销商」。

examples.en: We distinguished an authorized dealer from a shop reselling the same brand independently.
examples.zh: 我们把「授权经销商」与独立转售同一品牌商品的商店区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Independent wholesaler taking ownership of goods for resale to businesses

examples.en: The case shows a merchant wholesaler buying notebooks before reselling them to shops.
examples.zh: 案例展示了一家「经销型批发商」先买下笔记本，再转售给商店。

examples.en: We checked whether the merchant wholesaler owned the goods shown in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们查看示意图中的商品是否由「经销型批发商」拥有。

words.enDefinition: Wholesaler providing a wide range of services alongside product resale

examples.en: The full-service wholesaler in our example stocks goods and delivers them to stores.
examples.zh: 示例中的「全服务批发商」既储存商品，也负责送货到门店。

examples.en: We compared the full-service wholesaler with a supplier offering only basic collection.
examples.zh: 我们将「全服务批发商」与只提供基本自提服务的供应商作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Wholesaler offering a narrower range of support services alongside resale

examples.en: The case uses a limited-service wholesaler that stocks merchandise without providing regular deliveries.
examples.zh: 案例使用一家持有商品库存但不定期送货的「有限服务批发商」。

examples.en: We mapped the retailer's responsibilities after choosing a limited-service wholesaler for the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们在选择了「有限服务批发商」之后列出了零售商要负责的事项。

words.enDefinition: Wholesaler whose buyers pay at purchase and transport their own goods

examples.en: A fictional café owner buys supplies from a cash-and-carry wholesaler in the case.
examples.zh: 案例里，一家虚构咖啡馆的经营者从「现付自运批发商」采购物资。

examples.en: We identified collection by the buyer as part of the cash-and-carry wholesaler model.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出由买家提货是「现付自运批发商」模式的一部分。

words.enDefinition: Wholesaler selling and delivering goods from a vehicle along a route

examples.en: The case shows a truck wholesaler selling stock to shops along a single route.
examples.zh: 案例展示了一家「车载批发商」沿一条路线向各家商店销售车载商品。

examples.en: We traced the stock sold by the truck wholesaler during its scheduled stops.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了「车载批发商」在安排好的各个停靠点出售的库存。

words.enDefinition: Wholesaler supplying products and managing their display racks inside retail stores

examples.en: The class example uses a rack jobber to restock and manage a greeting-card rack.
examples.zh: 课堂示例使用「货架代营批发商」补货并管理贺卡陈列架。

examples.en: We checked who maintained the shelf before identifying the rack jobber in the scenario.
examples.zh: 我们先查看谁维护货架，再辨认出情境里的「货架代营批发商」。

collocations: displays managed by a rack jobber

words.enDefinition: Wholesaler carrying merchandise across a broad range of product lines

examples.en: The case shows a full-line wholesaler supplying stationery, packaging, and basic shop equipment.
examples.zh: 案例展示一家「综合型批发商」供应文具、包装用品和基本门店设备。

examples.en: We compared a full-line wholesaler with a supplier specializing in paper alone.
examples.zh: 我们将「综合型批发商」与只经营纸品的供应商作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Producer-operated office handling sales without maintaining local stock for those sales

examples.en: The shelf fixtures are ordered through a manufacturer's sales office but ship from the factory.
examples.zh: 货架装置经由「制造商销售办事处」订购，但由工厂发货。

examples.en: We distinguished the manufacturer's sales office from a branch that holds and ships stock.
examples.zh: 我们把「制造商销售办事处」与持有库存并负责发货的分公司区分开来。

collocations: sales handled by a manufacturer's sales office

words.enDefinition: Intermediary bringing wholesale buyers and sellers together for particular transactions

examples.en: The hypothetical merchandise broker brings an independent store and a supplier together.
examples.zh: 假想的「商品交易经纪人」为独立商店和供应商牵线。

examples.en: We discussed the fee paid to the merchandise broker for arranging the sale.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为促成交易而支付给「商品交易经纪人」的费用。

collocations: deal arranged by a merchandise broker

words.enDefinition: Dividing large purchases into smaller quantities for resale to downstream buyers

examples.en: The case illustrates breaking bulk when large shipments become smaller orders for neighborhood shops.
examples.zh: 案例用把大批来货拆成社区商店的小订单来说明「批量拆分销售」。

examples.en: Our group identified breaking bulk as one service provided by the intermediary.
examples.zh: 我们组将「批量拆分销售」辨认为这家中间商提供的一项服务。

words.enDefinition: Number or range of different product categories carried by a retailer

examples.en: The outlet has greater assortment breadth because it sells more types of goods.
examples.zh: 这家零售网点销售更多类型的商品，因此「商品组合广度」更高。

examples.en: We counted categories to estimate assortment breadth in the fictional shop comparison.
examples.zh: 我们通过数商品类别来估计虚构商店对比中的「商品组合广度」。

words.enDefinition: Number or range of choices within a particular product category

examples.en: The store offers greater assortment depth in paper than in any other category.
examples.zh: 这家商店在纸品上的「商品组合深度」比其他任何类别都高。

examples.en: We examined colors and sizes before comparing assortment depth in the sample stores.
examples.zh: 我们先查看颜色和尺寸，再对比样例商店的「商品组合深度」。

words.enDefinition: Deciding which product categories and variants a retailer will carry

examples.en: The class uses assortment planning to balance category variety against available shelf space.
examples.zh: 课堂通过「商品组合规划」平衡商品类别多样性与可用货架空间。

examples.en: Our group discussed assortment planning for a small store selling study supplies.
examples.zh: 我们组讨论了一家销售学习用品的小店的「商品组合规划」。

words.enDefinition: Type of retail operation defined by its assortment, service, and selling method

examples.en: The class compares a membership warehouse with another retail format offering personal assistance.
examples.zh: 课堂对比了会员仓储店与另一种提供专人协助的「零售业态」。

examples.en: We identified the retail format by looking at the seller's assortment and service model.
examples.zh: 我们通过查看卖家的商品组合和服务模式来辨认「零售业态」。

words.enDefinition: Retail outlet concentrating on a limited category with relatively deep assortment

examples.en: The reading describes a specialty store with a large selection of bicycle accessories.
examples.zh: 阅读材料描述了一家自行车配件选择很多的「专业商店」。

examples.en: We compared the specialty store with a larger retailer carrying many unrelated categories.
examples.zh: 我们将这家「专业商店」与经营多个无关类别的大型零售商作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Retail outlet emphasizing low prices, usually with relatively limited service

examples.en: The case describes a discount store selling basic products with minimal personal assistance.
examples.zh: 案例描述了一家销售基本商品、很少提供专人协助的「折扣商店」。

examples.en: We discussed the fixed costs of the discount store in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂练习中讨论了「折扣商店」的固定成本。

words.enDefinition: Retailer selling branded merchandise below typical prices using opportunistic sourcing

examples.en: The fictional off-price retailer sells surplus branded items acquired from several producers.
examples.zh: 虚构的「低价品牌折扣零售商」出售从多家生产商购入的品牌余货。

examples.en: We compared the changing stock of an off-price retailer with a standard assortment.
examples.zh: 我们将一家「低价品牌折扣零售商」不断变化的库存与常规商品组合作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Retail outlet operated by a manufacturer or brand to sell its goods

examples.en: The fictional clothing producer sells remaining items through its own factory outlet.
examples.zh: 虚构服装生产商通过自己的「工厂直销店」出售余货。

examples.en: We distinguished a manufacturer's factory outlet from a shop that bought excess inventory independently.
examples.zh: 我们把制造商的「工厂直销店」与独立购入过剩库存的商店区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Large specialist retailer offering a dominant assortment within a category

examples.en: The example describes a category killer carrying a very broad selection of home tools.
examples.zh: 示例描述了一家家用工具选择极多的「品类主导型大店」。

examples.en: We compared the category killer with smaller specialists in the same fictional town.
examples.zh: 我们将「品类主导型大店」与同一虚构城镇中规模更小的专业店作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Large retailer selling broadly appealing merchandise across numerous categories

examples.en: The case contrasts a mass merchandiser offering everyday goods with a niche retailer.
examples.zh: 案例把经营日常用品的「大众商品零售商」与小众零售商作了对照。

examples.en: We noted how many categories the mass merchandiser carried in the sample layout.
examples.zh: 我们记录了示例布局中「大众商品零售商」经营多少个类别。

words.enDefinition: Retailer providing extensive personal assistance and related services throughout a purchase

examples.en: The fictional full-service retailer helps customers compare options and arranges delivery after purchase.
examples.zh: 虚构的「全服务零售商」帮助顾客比较选项，并在购买后安排送货。

examples.en: We compared the full-service retailer with a store offering only basic assistance.
examples.zh: 我们将「全服务零售商」与仅提供基本协助的商店相比较。

words.enDefinition: Retail business operating multiple stores under common control or branding

examples.en: The retail chain in our case uses the same name at every location.
examples.zh: 案例中的「连锁零售企业」在所有地点使用相同的名称。

examples.en: We compared one retail chain location with an independently operated shop nearby.
examples.zh: 我们将「连锁零售企业」的一家门店与附近一家独立经营的店作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Retail business operated separately from a larger chain or affiliated owner

examples.en: The fictional independent retailer chooses which products to stock without a central purchasing office.
examples.zh: 虚构的「独立零售商」自行决定备哪些货，无需中央采购部门。

examples.en: We compared the independent retailer with a centrally managed store from the case.
examples.zh: 我们将「独立零售商」与案例中一家集中管理的门店作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Selling to consumers through channels outside physical retail stores

examples.en: The lecture illustrates nonstore retailing using online catalogs and a vending example.
examples.zh: 讲座用线上目录和自动售货的例子说明「无店铺零售」。

examples.en: Our group discussed nonstore retailing before mapping the fictional brand's direct sales channels.
examples.zh: 我们组先讨论「无店铺零售」，再绘制虚构品牌的直接销售渠道。

words.enDefinition: In e-commerce, a retailer that sells online and operates no physical stores for customers.

examples.en: The case introduces a pure-play retailer that ships all purchases from its warehouse.
examples.zh: 案例介绍了一家所有商品都从仓库发出的「纯线上零售商」。

examples.en: We compared the pure-play retailer with a seller that also operated neighborhood stores.
examples.zh: 我们将「纯线上零售商」与同时经营社区门店的卖家作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Retailer selling through both physical stores and online shopping channels

examples.en: The brick-and-click retailer in the example sells through its website and two stores.
examples.zh: 示例中的「线上线下结合零售商」既通过网站销售，也经营两家门店。

examples.en: We asked how the brick-and-click retailer shares product information across its two channels.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「线上线下结合零售商」如何在两个渠道之间共享产品信息。

words.enDefinition: Selling through a temporary physical location for a limited period

examples.en: The case uses pop-up retailing for a weekend display of student-made stationery.
examples.zh: 案例用「快闪零售」开展持续一个周末的学生自制文具展售。

examples.en: We compared pop-up retailing with a longer lease in the fictional shopping center.
examples.zh: 我们比较了在虚构购物中心开展「快闪零售」和签订更长期租约的做法。

words.enDefinition: Branded retail space operating within a larger host retailer's premises

examples.en: The fictional bookstore hosts a store-within-a-store selling supplies for art students.
examples.zh: 虚构书店引入了一个向艺术专业学生销售用品的「店中店」。

examples.en: We marked the store-within-a-store separately from the host's own merchandise on the plan.
examples.zh: 我们在平面图上将「店中店」与主商店自己的商品分开标注。

words.enDefinition: A retailer offering members a wide range of goods, often in bulk, in a low-service warehouse setting.

examples.en: The lecture describes a warehouse club that sells larger packages to members.
examples.zh: 讲座描述了一家向会员出售大包装商品的「仓储会员店」。

examples.en: We compared the warehouse club with a supermarket offering smaller package sizes.
examples.zh: 我们将「仓储会员店」与提供较小规格包装的超市作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Presentation of retail merchandise through displays and other visual elements

examples.en: The tutorial uses visual merchandising to explain how the display groups related goods.
examples.zh: 辅导课用「视觉陈列」解释展台如何将相关商品放在一起。

examples.en: The student team compared visual merchandising in two layouts for the same shop.
examples.zh: 学生团队对比了同一家商店两种布局的「视觉陈列」。

words.enDefinition: Arrangement of merchandise or imagery in a shop's outward-facing window

examples.en: The student project uses a window display to introduce the store's new assortment.
examples.zh: 学生项目通过「橱窗陈列」介绍商店的新商品组合。

examples.en: We sketched a window display that grouped notebooks by cover design.
examples.zh: 我们画了一张按封面设计摆放笔记本的「橱窗陈列」草图。

words.enDefinition: Diagram specifying where products should be placed on retail shelves

examples.en: The workbook includes a planogram showing where each product belongs on the shelf.
examples.zh: 练习册有一张「货架陈列图」，标出了各项商品在货架上的位置。

examples.en: We used the planogram to check where the larger packages had been placed.
examples.zh: 我们借助「货架陈列图」查看大包装商品放在了哪里。

words.enDefinition: Number of visible front-facing units allocated to a product on shelves

examples.en: The class compares shelf facings for two items sharing the same shelf.
examples.zh: 课堂比较了共用同一货架的两款商品的「货架陈列面数」。

examples.en: We counted the shelf facings from the aisle, excluding stock behind the front row.
examples.zh: 我们站在通道里数「货架陈列面数」，未把后排库存算进去。

words.expression: gross margin return on inventory investment
words.lemma: gross margin return on inventory investment
words.enDefinition: Gross margin earned per unit of money invested in average inventory
acceptedEnVariants: gross margin return on inventory investment

examples.en: The sample statement compares gross margin return on inventory investment across two categories with similar sales.
examples.zh: 样本报表对比了销售额相近的两个品类的「库存投资毛利回报率」。

examples.en: We discussed why gross margin return on inventory investment depends on more than the category's margin percentage.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么「库存投资毛利回报率」还取决于品类毛利率之外的因素。

collocations: calculate gross margin return on inventory investment
report gross margin return on inventory investment
compare gross margin return on inventory investment

words.enDefinition: Sales from a comparable group of stores operating in both reporting periods

examples.en: The sample report separates same-store sales from revenue at the newly opened locations.
examples.zh: 示例报告把「可比门店销售额」与新开门店的收入分开列出。

examples.en: We used same-store sales to compare the established stores across two fictional years.
examples.zh: 我们用「可比门店销售额」比较两个虚构年度里既有门店的表现。

words.enDefinition: Retail sales divided by the relevant floor area measured in square feet

examples.en: The workbook compares sales per square foot for two layouts with different amounts of selling space.
examples.zh: 练习册比较了销售面积不同的两种布局的「每平方英尺销售额」。

examples.en: Our project uses sales per square foot to examine how much revenue each layout generates.
examples.zh: 我们用「每平方英尺销售额」考察各种布局的创收表现。

words.enDefinition: Business result a company intends to achieve through its pricing

examples.en: The case identifies the pricing objective before discussing what the product should cost.
examples.zh: 案例先明确「定价目标」，再讨论产品应该定在什么价格。

examples.en: We compared two plans because their stated pricing objective differed from the start.
examples.zh: 我们对比了两项方案，因为它们一开始设定的「定价目标」就不同。

words.enDefinition: Setting prices primarily to increase sales volume or market share

examples.en: The case models sales-oriented pricing by giving sales volume priority over immediate profit.
examples.zh: 案例将销量置于眼前利润之上，以示范「销量导向定价」。

examples.en: We identified sales-oriented pricing after checking which outcome the classroom model emphasized.
examples.zh: 我们查看课堂模型着重追求哪项结果后，识别出了「销量导向定价」。

words.enDefinition: Setting prices primarily to reach a profit or return goal

examples.en: The report uses profit-oriented pricing to compare scenarios with the same expected sales volume.
examples.zh: 报告用「利润导向定价」比较预期销量相同的几个情境。

examples.en: We discussed profit-oriented pricing when the fictional firm gave earnings priority over growth.
examples.zh: 虚构公司将收益置于增长之上时，我们讨论了「利润导向定价」。

collocations: contrast profit-oriented pricing with sales targets

words.enDefinition: Condition that determines which customers or transactions qualify for a price

examples.en: The case labels the difference in refund flexibility as a price fence.
examples.zh: 案例把退款灵活性的差别标为一项「价格区隔条件」。

examples.en: We discussed whether the price fence was clear in the example's price table.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了示例价目表中的「价格区隔条件」是否清楚。

words.enDefinition: Keeping prices low by offering basic features and minimizing costs

examples.en: The fictional stationery brand uses economy pricing for a notebook with basic features.
examples.zh: 虚构文具品牌对功能基本的笔记本采用「经济型定价」。

examples.en: We compared economy pricing with a higher price for a more elaborate product.
examples.zh: 我们将「经济型定价」与为功能更丰富的产品定更高价格的做法作了比较。

collocations: compare economy pricing with premium pricing

words.enDefinition: Setting prices mainly from the cost of producing or delivering an offering

examples.en: The team modeled cost-based pricing before comparing prices with competing products in the exercise.
examples.zh: 团队先模拟「成本导向定价」，再在练习中与竞争产品的价格作比较。

examples.en: We discussed which cost categories were included in the cost-based pricing calculation.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「成本导向定价」的计算涵盖哪些成本类别。

words.enDefinition: Setting prices mainly with reference to competing offers in the market

examples.en: The case illustrates competition-based pricing by starting from the prices of rival products.
examples.zh: 案例从竞争产品的价格出发，说明「竞争导向定价」。

examples.en: We contrasted competition-based pricing with pricing based only on the seller's costs.
examples.zh: 我们将「竞争导向定价」与仅根据卖家成本定价作了比较。

collocations: compare competition-based pricing with cost estimates

words.enDefinition: Setting a price close to the prevailing price for comparable offerings

examples.en: The business exercise describes going-rate pricing among several sellers offering a similar service.
examples.zh: 商务练习描述了几家提供类似服务的卖家如何「随行就市定价」。

examples.en: We discussed whether going-rate pricing left much room for different price levels.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「随行就市定价」是否还给不同价格水平留下多少空间。

words.enDefinition: Introducing an offering at a high price and reducing it over time

examples.en: The mock launch plan uses price skimming and schedules gradual reductions after introduction.
examples.zh: 模拟上市方案采用「撇脂定价」，并安排上市后逐步降价。

examples.en: We compared price skimming with a launch strategy aiming for widespread early adoption.
examples.zh: 我们将「撇脂定价」与旨在上市初期获得广泛采用的策略作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Introducing an offering at a low price to gain market share quickly

examples.en: The case illustrates market penetration pricing through a low launch price intended to build share.
examples.zh: 案例用旨在扩大市场份额的低上市价说明「市场渗透定价」。

examples.en: We compared market penetration pricing with a plan that charged more at launch.
examples.zh: 我们将「市场渗透定价」与上市时定价较高的方案作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Setting or presenting prices to influence how buyers perceive those prices

examples.en: The tutorial examines psychological pricing by asking how people interpret two nearby prices.
examples.zh: 辅导课通过询问人们如何理解两个相近价位来考察「心理定价」。

examples.en: We discussed psychological pricing without assuming that everyone reacts to prices the same way.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「心理定价」，没有假定每个人对价格的反应都一样。

words.enDefinition: Using odd or rounded price endings to convey different price impressions

examples.en: The example uses odd-even pricing to contrast a near-round price with a round one.
examples.zh: 示例用「奇偶定价」对比了接近整数的价格与整数价格。

examples.en: Our group discussed odd-even pricing after comparing two price tags for the same item.
examples.zh: 我们组对照了同一商品的两张价格标签后，讨论了「奇偶定价」。

words.enDefinition: Setting a high price partly to signal quality, exclusivity, or status

examples.en: The case illustrates prestige pricing for a fictional limited series of desk accessories.
examples.zh: 案例用一套虚构的限量桌面用品来说明「声望定价」。

examples.en: We discussed prestige pricing when the high price itself was part of the signal.
examples.zh: 当高价本身就是信号的一部分时，我们讨论了「声望定价」。

words.enDefinition: Price a buyer mentally uses as a comparison based on prior experience

examples.en: The exercise illustrates an internal reference price with a shopper recalling a previous purchase.
examples.zh: 习题用购物者回想过去一次购买的情形说明「内在参考价格」。

examples.en: We discussed how a remembered price becomes an internal reference price in the example.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在示例中，记忆中的价格如何成为「内在参考价格」。

collocations: compare with an internal reference price

words.enDefinition: Comparison price supplied by an external source such as a displayed price

examples.en: The example labels the displayed comparison amount as an external reference price for shoppers.
examples.zh: 示例把展示出来的对比金额标为购物者的「外在参考价格」。

examples.en: We explained why an external reference price does not come from the buyer's memory.
examples.zh: 我们解释了为什么「外在参考价格」并非来自买家的记忆。

collocations: compare against an external reference price

words.enDefinition: Grouping assorted merchandise at a limited set of distinct price points

examples.en: The classroom retailer uses price lining to group notebooks at three set prices.
examples.zh: 课堂案例里的零售商采用「分档定价」，把笔记本分到三个固定价位。

examples.en: We compared price lining with a price list using a different amount for every item.
examples.zh: 我们把「分档定价」与每件商品各自定一个金额的价目表作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Coordinating prices across related versions or tiers within a product line

examples.en: The mock company uses product line pricing to price three versions of the same lamp.
examples.zh: 模拟公司通过「产品线定价」为同一款灯的三个版本定价。

examples.en: We discussed product line pricing by comparing price gaps between models in the same range.
examples.zh: 我们比较了同一系列各型号的价差，以讨论「产品线定价」。

words.enDefinition: Setting separate prices for optional additions alongside a core product price

examples.en: The case illustrates optional-product pricing by listing the carrying case separately from the device.
examples.zh: 案例将收纳包与设备分开列价，以说明「可选配件定价」。

examples.en: We checked which items were optional before discussing optional-product pricing in the workbook.
examples.zh: 练习册讨论「可选配件定价」之前，我们先确认哪些商品是可选的。

words.enDefinition: Coordinating the prices of a core product and complementary supplies it requires

examples.en: The fictional dispenser case illustrates captive-product pricing with refills required during normal use.
examples.zh: 虚构分配器案例用正常使用所需的补充装说明「必需配套品定价」。

examples.en: We discussed how captive-product pricing connects the device price and the required refill price.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「必需配套品定价」如何将设备价格与必需补充装价格联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Pricing secondary outputs that arise when making a primary product

examples.en: The case illustrates by-product pricing when a workshop sells usable offcuts alongside its main output.
examples.zh: 案例用工作室在销售主要产品之外还出售可用边角料的情形说明「副产品定价」。

examples.en: We discussed whether by-product pricing could offset some costs in the hypothetical example.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在假想例子中，「副产品定价」能否抵消部分成本。

words.enDefinition: Pricing selected products below cost to attract purchases of other goods

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates loss-leader pricing with one grocery item sold below cost to attract shoppers.
examples.zh: 习题以一款低于成本销售、用来吸引顾客的食品为例，说明「亏本引流定价」。

examples.en: We discussed whether loss-leader pricing depended on purchases beyond the discounted item.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「亏本引流定价」是否依赖顾客购买折扣商品之外的其他商品。

words.enDefinition: Keeping regular prices low and relatively stable with few temporary promotions

examples.en: The case contrasts everyday low pricing with frequent changes between regular and promotional prices.
examples.zh: 案例把「天天低价策略」与经常在常规价和促销价之间切换作了对照。

examples.en: We checked how the mock calendar reflected everyday low pricing during the semester.
examples.zh: 我们查看模拟日历在学期内如何体现「天天低价策略」。

collocations: compare everyday low pricing with promotions

words.enDefinition: Maintaining higher regular prices and offering intermittent discounts or sales

examples.en: The fictional store uses high-low pricing and discounts selected goods during occasional promotions.
examples.zh: 虚构商店采用「高低价策略」，在偶尔开展的促销中对部分商品打折。

examples.en: We illustrated high-low pricing by plotting regular prices and sale periods on a chart.
examples.zh: 我们把常规价和促销时段画在图上，以说明「高低价策略」。

collocations: contrast high-low pricing with stable prices

words.enDefinition: Setting a retail price at twice the wholesale cost

examples.en: The workbook uses keystone pricing when the retailer doubles the price paid wholesale.
examples.zh: 练习册用零售商按批发采购价翻倍的情形来说明「批发价翻倍定价」。

examples.en: We discussed why keystone pricing gives a different percentage when expressed as margin.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么把「批发价翻倍定价」表示为销售毛利率时，百分比会不同。

words.enDefinition: Reduction of an item's current retail selling price from its earlier level

examples.en: The store in the example records a retail markdown on its remaining seasonal stock.
examples.zh: 示例中的商店对剩余的季节性库存记录了一次「零售价下调」。

examples.en: We compared the original and revised prices to calculate the retail markdown.
examples.zh: 我们对照原价和调整后的价格，计算「零售价下调」幅度。

words.enDefinition: Supplier contribution covering part of a retailer's reduction in selling price

examples.en: The fictional supplier provides a markdown allowance to share the cost of clearance reductions.
examples.zh: 虚构供应商提供「降价补贴」，以分担清仓降价的成本。

examples.en: We separated the markdown allowance from the reduction shoppers saw on the tag.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「降价补贴」和购物者在标签上看到的降价。

words.enDefinition: Price reduction offered for purchases made during a designated seasonal period

examples.en: The workbook describes a seasonal discount for retailers ordering display fixtures outside peak season.
examples.zh: 练习册描述了零售商在销售淡季订购展示设备时获得的「季节折扣」。

examples.en: We checked when buyers qualified for the seasonal discount in the example.
examples.zh: 我们查看了示例中买家什么时候能享受「季节折扣」。

words.enDefinition: Reduction in the invoice amount offered for payment within an earlier period

examples.en: The hypothetical invoice offers a cash discount for payment before the regular due date.
examples.zh: 假想发票对在常规到期日前付款的客户提供「现金折扣」。

examples.en: We discussed how the cash discount differs from a reduction based on order size.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「现金折扣」与按订单大小减价有何区别。

words.enDefinition: Price reduction based on purchases accumulated over a specified period

examples.en: The fictional supplier calculates a cumulative quantity discount based on all orders during the term.
examples.zh: 虚构供应商根据整个约定期间的所有订单计算「累计数量折扣」。

examples.en: We discussed why the cumulative quantity discount was based on several transactions together.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「累计数量折扣」为什么要综合多笔交易来计算。

collocations: qualify for a cumulative quantity discount

words.enDefinition: Setting a common delivered price within each designated geographical zone

examples.en: The case uses zone pricing so delivery-inclusive prices differ between the two regions.
examples.zh: 案例采用「分区定价」，使两个地区的含运费价格有所不同。

examples.en: We mapped the zones before comparing the prices set under zone pricing.
examples.zh: 我们先画出各个区域，再比较「分区定价」下设定的价格。

words.enDefinition: Charging the same delivery-inclusive price regardless of the buyer's covered location

examples.en: The diagram uses uniform delivered pricing for two locations with different underlying delivery costs.
examples.zh: 图表对实际配送成本不同的两个地点采用「统一到货定价」。

examples.en: We compared uniform delivered pricing with a plan charging different amounts by region.
examples.zh: 我们将「统一到货定价」与按地区收取不同金额的方案作了比较。

collocations: contrast uniform delivered pricing with zone prices

words.enDefinition: Breakdown showing adjustments from list price to actual net transaction price

examples.en: The price waterfall in the workbook shows how rebates reduce net revenue per sale.
examples.zh: 练习册里的「价格瀑布图」展示了返利如何降低每笔交易的净收入。

examples.en: We traced the two adjustments highlighted in the fictional price waterfall diagram.
examples.zh: 我们追踪了虚构「价格瀑布图」中突出的两项价格调整。

words.enDefinition: Ratio of actual net transaction prices to stated or targeted prices

examples.en: The sample report shows price realization below the target despite an advertised increase.
examples.zh: 样本报告显示，虽然公告已提价，「实际价格达成率」仍低于目标。

examples.en: We discussed price realization after reviewing the net revenue per unit in the case.
examples.zh: 我们查看案例中单位商品的净收入后，讨论了「实际价格达成率」。

words.enDefinition: Design of package sizes and their corresponding price points within an assortment

examples.en: The exercise uses price-pack architecture to compare prices for three package sizes.
examples.zh: 练习用「包装规格价格体系」比较三种包装规格的价格。

examples.en: Our group mapped the price-pack architecture for a fictional range of stationery packs.
examples.zh: 我们组绘制了一套虚构文具套装的「包装规格价格体系」。

words.enDefinition: Use of the same price for a comparable offer across sales channels

examples.en: The fictional retailer checks channel price parity for the same product online and in stores.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商核对同一商品在线上和门店的「渠道价格一致性」。

examples.en: We discussed channel price parity after finding identical prices in the two sample channels.
examples.zh: 发现两个示例渠道价格相同后，我们讨论了「渠道价格一致性」。

collocations: compare evidence of channel price parity

words.enDefinition: Selling through multiple channels that may operate as separate parts of the business

examples.en: The example uses multichannel retailing through its website, printed catalog, and neighborhood shops.
examples.zh: 案例企业通过网站、印刷目录和社区商店开展「多渠道零售」。

examples.en: We discussed multichannel retailing even though each channel in the case kept separate records.
examples.zh: 尽管案例中各渠道分别保存记录，我们仍讨论了其「多渠道零售」模式。

words.enDefinition: Coordinated selling across channels so customers can move between them smoothly

examples.en: The case illustrates omnichannel retailing by connecting product discovery, checkout, and pickup across channels.
examples.zh: 案例将跨渠道的商品查找、结账和取货连接起来，说明「全渠道零售」。

examples.en: We compared omnichannel retailing with an approach that kept online and store systems separate.
examples.zh: 我们把「全渠道零售」与线上和实体店系统分开运行的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Retail approach using a shared platform and data across selling channels

examples.en: The technology diagram shows unified commerce through one system for inventory and transactions.
examples.zh: 技术示意图通过一个同时管理库存和交易的系统展示了「统一商业系统」。

examples.en: We discussed unified commerce after comparing separate records with a single shared record.
examples.zh: 我们对比分渠道记录与单一共享记录后，讨论了「统一商业系统」。

words.enDefinition: Online spaces where shoppers find, compare, and view products for sale

examples.en: The fictional retailer shows a product's pictures and details on its digital shelf.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商在「数字货架」上展示产品的图片和详细信息。

examples.en: Our group compared the digital shelf with the display in the physical store.
examples.zh: 我们组比较了「数字货架」和实体店里的商品陈列。

collocations: product visibility on the digital shelf

words.enDefinition: Examining an item in a physical store before purchasing it online

examples.en: The case describes showrooming when a shopper tries the item before ordering online.
examples.zh: 案例描述购物者先到店试用再上网下单的「先看店后网购」行为。

examples.en: We mapped showrooming as a journey beginning in the physical shop.
examples.zh: 我们把「先看店后网购」画成一条从实体店开始的购物路径。

words.enDefinition: Researching a product online before buying it in a physical store

examples.en: The worksheet illustrates webrooming when a shopper researches models online and buys in store.
examples.zh: 习题用购物者先在线上查看型号、再到门店购买的情形说明「先网查后到店购」。

examples.en: We mapped webrooming separately from the path that ended with online checkout.
examples.zh: 我们将「先网查后到店购」和最后在线上结账的路径分开绘制。

words.enDefinition: Fulfillment option in which a retail store ships orders from its inventory

examples.en: The fictional retailer offers ship from store when its warehouse runs out of a product.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商的仓库缺某款商品时，会提供「门店发货」。

examples.en: We compared ship from store with shipping the same online order from a central warehouse.
examples.zh: 我们将「门店发货」与由中央仓库发出同一线上订单的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: In-store ordering access to products not physically stocked in that store

examples.en: The mock store uses an endless aisle to offer colors missing from its shelves.
examples.zh: 模拟商店利用「无限货架」提供实体货架上没有的颜色。

examples.en: We discussed how the endless aisle extends the assortment available through the shop.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「无限货架」如何扩大购物者通过门店能买到的商品范围。

words.enDefinition: Retail option allowing merchandise bought online to be returned at a store

examples.en: The fictional retailer lists "Buy online, return in store" as an option for eligible website orders.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商将「线上购买门店退货」列为符合条件的网站订单可用的选项。

examples.en: We discussed how "Buy online, return in store" connects the website's records with the stores.
examples.zh: 我们考察了「线上购买门店退货」如何把网站订单记录与实体门店连接起来。

collocations: offer buy online, return in store
buy online, return in store policy
buy online, return in store service

words.enDefinition: Coordinating order delivery or pickup across multiple sales and inventory channels

examples.en: The case uses omnichannel fulfillment to handle web orders from stores or warehouses.
examples.zh: 案例采用「全渠道履约」，由门店或仓库处理网站订单。

examples.en: We discussed whether the two pickup methods used the same omnichannel fulfillment process.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了两种取货方式是否使用相同的「全渠道履约」流程。

words.enDefinition: System coordinating order fulfillment across multiple sources of inventory or service

examples.en: The model uses distributed order management to coordinate orders across two warehouses and several shops.
examples.zh: 模型利用「分布式订单管理」在两个仓库和几家商店之间协调订单。

examples.en: We discussed how distributed order management differs from handling orders within a single location.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了「分布式订单管理」与仅在一个地点处理订单有何不同。

words.enDefinition: Ability to see stock quantities, availability, and locations across the network

examples.en: The dashboard in the case improves inventory visibility by showing stock at every store.
examples.zh: 案例中的仪表板展示每家门店的库存，以提高「库存可视性」。

examples.en: We compared inventory visibility across the two versions of the fictional stock dashboard.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构库存仪表板两个版本的「库存可视性」。

words.enDefinition: Keeping inventory records consistent across systems when stock changes

examples.en: The example shows inventory synchronization after a store sale changes the quantity displayed online.
examples.zh: 示例显示，门店销售改变网上显示的数量后，完成了「库存同步」。

examples.en: We discussed how delayed inventory synchronization could explain the mismatch in the example.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了滞后的「库存同步」如何解释示例中的不一致。

words.enDefinition: Stock made jointly available to satisfy demand from several outlets or channels

examples.en: The fictional retailer uses pooled inventory for both store purchases and online orders.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商为门店购买和线上订单使用同一份「共享库存」。

examples.en: We compared pooled inventory with a design that holds separate stock for each channel.
examples.zh: 我们将「共享库存」与每个渠道各自储备库存的方案作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Uncommitted quantity available to meet a new order by a specified date

examples.en: The exercise excludes quantities already reserved when reporting available-to-promise inventory for new orders.
examples.zh: 练习在报告新订单的「可承诺库存」时，排除了已经预留的数量。

examples.en: We checked why available-to-promise inventory differed from the total quantity physically in stock.
examples.zh: 我们核对了为什么「可承诺库存」与实际在库总量不同。

words.enDefinition: Assigning an order to a location that will prepare or fulfill it

examples.en: The diagram shows order routing assigning the fictional order to a nearby store.
examples.zh: 图示中，「订单分派」将虚构订单分配给附近一家门店。

examples.en: We compared order routing rules based on stock availability and fulfillment distance.
examples.zh: 我们比较了依库存可用性和履约距离分配订单的「订单分派」规则。

words.enDefinition: Location in a network that can prepare, ship, or release customer orders

examples.en: The case treats each store as a fulfillment node for certain online orders.
examples.zh: 案例将各家门店视为某些线上订单的「履约节点」。

examples.en: We labeled each fulfillment node on the map before assigning any sample orders.
examples.zh: 我们在分配样本订单之前，先在地图上标出了各个「履约节点」。

words.enDefinition: Compact facility located near customers for preparing online retail orders

examples.en: The plan places a microfulfillment center closer to customers than the main warehouse.
examples.zh: 方案把「微型履约中心」设在比主仓库更靠近顾客的地点。

examples.en: We compared the microfulfillment center with a central facility serving the entire region.
examples.zh: 我们将「微型履约中心」与服务整个地区的中央设施作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Outsourced logistics services provided by an independent specialist business

examples.en: The fictional retailer uses third-party logistics for storage and dispatch during the project.
examples.zh: 虚构零售商在项目中采用「第三方物流」来储存和发运商品。

examples.en: We compared third-party logistics with the retailer managing those operations internally in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上对比了「第三方物流」与零售商自行管理这些业务的做法。

collocations: outsource to a third-party logistics provider

words.enDefinition: Final stage of moving an order to its intended recipient or destination

examples.en: The map shows last-mile delivery from a local depot to the customer's address.
examples.zh: 地图展示了从本地配送站到顾客地址的「最后一公里配送」。

examples.en: We compared two last-mile delivery routes in the simulated neighborhood for our project.
examples.zh: 我们为项目比较了模拟社区中的两条「最后一公里配送」路线。

words.enDefinition: Movement of products back through the supply chain for recovery or disposition

examples.en: The chart uses reverse logistics to trace returned items from stores back to warehouses.
examples.zh: 图表通过「逆向物流」追踪退回商品从门店回到仓库的过程。

examples.en: We discussed reverse logistics when the mock retailer sent returned goods for inspection.
examples.zh: 模拟零售商将退货送检时，我们讨论了「逆向物流」。

words.enDefinition: Combining returned products into fewer shipments before moving them onward

examples.en: The case illustrates returns consolidation when several stores send returns together for inspection.
examples.zh: 案例用几家门店把退货合在一起送检的情形说明「退货集运」。

examples.en: We compared returns consolidation with sending each returned item directly to the supplier.
examples.zh: 我们将「退货集运」与每件退货都直接寄给供应商的做法作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Fulfillment option sending an order to a store for customer collection

examples.en: The case offers ship-to-store when the pickup store lacks the ordered item.
examples.zh: 如果取货门店没有所订商品，案例就提供「发往门店自提」。

examples.en: We distinguished ship-to-store from reserving an item already on the store shelf.
examples.zh: 我们区分了「发往门店自提」与预留门店货架上已有的商品。

words.enDefinition: Fulfillment arrangement where a supplier ships goods directly to a retailer's customer

examples.en: The example uses drop shipping so the supplier sends orders directly to customers.
examples.zh: 示例采用「供应商代发货」，由供应商直接将订单商品寄给顾客。

examples.en: We contrasted drop shipping with the retailer stocking and shipping the product itself.
examples.zh: 我们把「供应商代发货」与零售商自行备货发货的做法作了对照。

words.enDefinition: Transferring incoming goods to outbound transport with little or no storage

examples.en: The warehouse model uses cross-docking to move incoming goods straight to outbound vehicles.
examples.zh: 仓库模型采用「越库转运」，将到货直接转到出库车辆。

examples.en: We discussed cross-docking after identifying which shipments bypassed long-term storage in the case.
examples.zh: 我们辨认出案例中哪些货物无需长期入库后，讨论了「越库转运」。

words.enDefinition: Supplier delivery to retail stores without passing through the retailer's distribution center

examples.en: The case uses direct store delivery for goods that bypass the retailer's central warehouse.
examples.zh: 案例对不经零售商中央仓库的货物采用「直送门店」。

examples.en: We traced direct store delivery from the supplier to the shelves in our exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在练习中追踪了从供应商到货架的「直送门店」流程。

words.enDefinition: Proportion of defined observations or demand occasions when stock is unavailable

examples.en: The store comparison reports the stockout rate based on daily checks for selected products.
examples.zh: 商店对比以对指定商品的每日检查为依据，报告「缺货率」。

examples.en: We discussed why the stockout rate changed when the observation window became longer.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么观察时段延长时，「缺货率」会发生变化。

words.enDefinition: Proportion of orders fulfilled completely from available stock

examples.en: The case counts only complete orders when reporting its order fill rate for the month.
examples.zh: 案例报告当月「订单满足率」时，分子只计能够全量满足的订单。

examples.en: We distinguished order fill rate from the percentage of individual units filled from stock.
examples.zh: 我们将「订单满足率」与各件商品中能从库存满足的比例区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Share of expected product listings available to shoppers on store shelves

examples.en: The worksheet measures on-shelf availability using repeated checks of products on the sales floor.
examples.zh: 习题通过反复检查销售区里的商品来测量「货架有货率」。

examples.en: We compared on-shelf availability with measures of whether stock was present anywhere in store.
examples.zh: 我们将「货架有货率」与衡量商品在门店任何位置是否有货的指标作了比较。

words.enDefinition: Delivery performance measured by whether orders arrive complete by the promised time

examples.en: The workbook counts an order toward on-time in-full delivery only if it meets both conditions.
examples.zh: 练习册规定，只有同时满足两个条件的订单才计为「准时足量交付」。

examples.en: We discussed why a complete but late order failed the on-time in-full delivery measure.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么送齐却迟到的订单不符合「准时足量交付」指标。

words.enDefinition: Share of orders delivered complete, on time, undamaged, and with accurate documentation

examples.en: The sample dashboard reports perfect order rate alongside the measure for timely delivery alone.
examples.zh: 样本仪表板将「完美订单率」和仅衡量及时送达的指标一同报告。

examples.en: We identified a missing document that lowered the perfect order rate in the fictional example.
examples.zh: 我们找出了虚构例子里导致「完美订单率」降低的一份缺失单据。
